Satellite name Nightjar (NanoAvionics IoD 1)
Spacecraft type CubeSat
Units or mass 3U
Status Was operational until 2024-08-23, 1 week? (NanoAvionics post on 2024-08-19 implies that commissioning has started and object indentified. Taiwan news talks about running out of power due to battery issues at low temperature. Last checked 2024-09-30)
Launched 2024-08-16
NORAD ID 60535
Deployer EXOpod Nova 12U/16U [Exolaunch]
Launcher Falcon 9 (Transporter-11)
Organisation Rapidtek Technologies
Institution Company
Entity Commercial
Nation (HQ) Taiwan
Nation (AIT) Lithuania
Manufacturer AIVT by NanoAvionics
Operator NanoAvionics
Oneliner

Two 3U satellites, equipped with an RGB imager and a software-defined radio (SDR), are set to perform in-orbit demonstrations.
Results

Ran out of power after just one week in space due to battery issues at low temperatures.

Failure cause Running out of power due to battery issues at low temperatures.
